title: New Loading Dock Procedure
titleZh: 新的裝卸貨區作業程序
paragraphs: Notice to all warehouse staff: starting Monday, every pallet must be loaded through Dock 3 only. Dock 1 and Dock 2 will be closed for repair. Please use the forklift carefully and check that each rack is stable before you place any additional load.

Every carton must be scanned using a barcode reader before it leaves the warehouse. This step supports inventory tracking and reduces shortage in the busy season. If you find any damage or defect, report it to the supervisor before loading continues.

Storage space near the entrance is reserved for urgent order that require same day dispatch. Please do not block this area using empty pallet or unused equipment. Thank you for your cooperation while this change is in effect.
